name: PhotonCommerce
description:
Photon Commerce is the Managed Agents platform for financial data intelligence delivering 99.9%+ accuracy guaranteed by contract. Photon turns unstructured invoices, receipts, bank statements, bills of lading, insurance documents, contracts, and other documents into validated, structured, audit-ready data.

Built on a deterministic agent pipeline trained on 55 million industrial documents and backed by a global expert review network of thousands of people, Photon delivers what generic large language models cannot: reproducible outputs, zero hallucination, and SLA-grade reliability at production scale. Photon's Managed Agents, business-rules engine, and Human-in-the-Loop verification work digitize across the full document to payment lifecycle.

Photon's Managed AI Agents (Standard, Flash, Turbo, and LightSpeed) are designed for maximum accuracy, delivering 99% accurate, verified data extraction across even the most complex documents. By combining advanced AI with multi-step validation workflows, Photon Commerce ensures the structured data you receive is reliable and consistent. The Instant Agent delivers fully automated results in seconds.

Browse recently processed documents, explore the field schema for every supported document type, and view connected account information - all without leaving the conversation. With a single click, open results in Photon Commerce to review or edit extracted data.

Effortlessly transform documents into accurate, searchable, and analyzable data with verified AI extraction.

_published_faq.name: How do I add PhotonCommerce to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add PhotonCommerce to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp-claude.photoncommerce.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the PhotonCommerce MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: PhotonCommerce provides these MCP tools: get_document, get_help, get_schema, list_doctypes, list_recent_docs, process_document, and who_am_i.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to PhotonCommerce?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to PhotonCommerce in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
PhotonCommerce requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
PhotonCommerce is developed by Photon Commerce. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
